changes.text: 主张白话也能作诗的胡适，其实自称是个保守的人，常对朋友说，语言文字是世界上最保守的东西，比宗教还保守。他最坚定的对手是梅光迪，此时在哈佛随一位保守派文学批评家深造；胡适说，正是梅光迪的强烈反对，把他“逼上梁山”。按他的解释，这句成语是说一个人为环境所迫，不得已做出违反本意的非常行为。另一位是在康乃尔的朋友任鸿隽，他曾作打油诗取笑胡适，湖上那首纪事诗也出自他手。

Hu, the man arguing that it could, called himself a conservative. He used to tell his friends that language and writing are the most conservative things in the world, more conservative than religion. His most determined opponent was Mei Guangdi, then studying at Harvard under a conservative literary critic; it was Mei's fierce opposition, Hu later said, that drove him to Liangshan. As Hu explained it, the Chinese idiom means being forced by circumstances into drastic action against one's own will. The other was Ren Hongjun, a friend at Cornell who once teased Hu in comic verse, and who had written the poem about the lake.
争论缩到了最后一处。用胡适的话说，朋友们「除了“诗”这个堡垒之外，其他方面已经全部向我让步了」。他把朋友们的理由排了队：一是从来没有诗人用俗语俗字作过诗，他自己也只找到一首、甚至只是一首中的几句；二是更能服人的一条，从来没有中国作家认真着实地用白话作诗，偶尔写几行，下意识里还是看不起白话。他的结论很简单：要说服朋友，只有以身作则，自己认真去试，除此之外没有别的办法。

The argument had shrunk to one last point. In Hu's words, his friends had conceded everything to him except the fortress of poetry. He set out their reasons in order. First, no poet had ever written verse in everyday words; Hu himself could find only one poem, perhaps only a few lines of one. Second, and more convincing, no Chinese writer had ever seriously tried; poets had dropped in a few vernacular lines on a whim, while unconsciously looking down on the spoken language. His conclusion was simple. To persuade his friends he had to set the example and seriously try writing vernacular poetry himself. There was no other way.

1916年7月26日，他写信给任鸿隽，说施耐庵、曹雪芹已经证明白话可以写好小说，「今尚需人实地试验白话是否可为韵文之利器耳」。他在给朋友们的信里说，就算失败一两次、甚至无数次，也可以不断试下去，直到证明白话究竟能不能作诗为止。他还打了个比方：「我此时练习白话诗文，颇似新辟一文学殖民地。」可惜要单身匹马前往，难得同伴，但他说自己去志已决。他也说，如果这块新地全是不毛之地，他也许终究还要回到“文言诗国”。七月底八月初，他决定不再写旧诗词。还没写出几首白话诗，他就先给下一本诗集取好了名字：《尝试集》。

On July 26, 1916, he wrote to Ren — paraphrased here — that Shi Nai'an and Cao Xueqin had already shown in practice that the spoken language was the right tool for the novel; what remained was for someone to test in practice whether it could be the tool of verse. Even if they failed once, twice or countless times, he told these friends, they could keep experimenting until they knew whether the vernacular could be poetry. He compared his practice in vernacular verse and prose to opening up a new literary colony. He would have to ride out alone, with few companions, but he said his mind was made up. He also wrote that if the new land turned out to be barren, he might end his days in the old kingdom of classical poetry after all. In late July and early August he decided to stop writing classical verse. Before he had written more than a few vernacular poems, he had already named his next collection: Experiments.

本文只依据一本书：胡适口述、唐德刚译注《胡适口述自传》（中国文史出版社，2020）第八章。按唐德刚说明，这一章的英文稿是从胡适《四十自述》的《逼上梁山》一章节译、经胡适手订后再回译成中文的，与原文多少有出入。因此这一章整体是当事人多年后的口述回忆。其中引述了他1916年7月6日的日记和7月26日致任鸿隽的信等当时文字，但本文依据的只是经胡适转引、再经英译与回译的文本，未核对原件。梅光迪、任鸿隽的言行都经胡适转述；胡适对“改良”措辞的解释是他事后的说法。唐德刚的注释属评论：他认为“文言是半死的文字”这句口号当年摧枯拉朽，但真实性值得重新商榷；他认为白话文百分之百成功，白话诗则还未脱离“尝试”阶段；他也记下反对者觉得胡适居功太多，1956年胡适在哈佛以此讲演时，后来为他作传的格里德嗤之以鼻。这些都是唐德刚的记述，本文未另行核验。关于白话诗的结果，胡适本人在同一章则说「四十年来的新诗更是大有成就」，同时承认新文学各部门发展并不平均。标为“作者推断”的段落是本文的解读，思考题中的场景是虚构的。

This piece rests on one book: Hu Shi's oral memoir, translated and annotated by Tang Degang (Chinese Literature and History Press, 2020), chapter 8. As Tang explains, the English draft of this chapter was abridged from the Driven to Liangshan chapter of Hu's Forty Self-Narratives, revised in Hu's own hand and then translated back into Chinese, and it differs from the original to some degree. The chapter as a whole is therefore a participant's oral recollection many years later. It quotes writings from the time, such as Hu's diary entry of July 6, 1916 and his letter to Ren Hongjun of July 26. This article relies only on those texts as Hu quoted them, then translated into English and back again, and has not checked the originals. Mei Guangdi's and Ren Hongjun's words and actions reach us through Hu, and his explanation of the moderate wording is his own later account. Tang's notes are commentary: he thought the slogan that the classical language is half dead was devastating in its day but that its truth deserves a fresh look; he judged vernacular prose a complete success and vernacular poetry not yet out of the experimental stage; and he records that Hu's opponents felt he claimed too much credit, and that when Hu gave this account in a 1956 lecture at Harvard, Jerome B. Grieder, later his biographer, scoffed. These are Tang's accounts and were not checked separately here. On the outcome for vernacular poetry, Hu himself says in the same chapter that the new poetry of the past forty years had achieved a great deal, while acknowledging that the different branches of the new literature developed unevenly. Paragraphs marked as the author's inference are this article's reading; the scenario in the question is fictional.

dispositions.rationale: 英文把释义改为胡适本人的解释：为环境所迫，不得已做出违反本意的非常行为。中文同步补上同一释义，两种语言保持一致。ev 增加 HS-E2。

evidence.quote: 这句中国成语是说一个人为环境所迫，不得已而做出违反他本意的非常行为

dispositions.rationale: 英文把 privately 改为 unconsciously；中文同步把“骨子里”改为“下意识里”，与证据中的“下意识的鄙弃”一致。

evidence.quote: 他们都对白话有一种下意识的鄙弃

dispositions.rationale: 中文把“找不到同伴”改为“难得同伴”，英文把 with no companions 改为 with few companions，与原信“不能多得同志”相符。

evidence.quote: 可惜须单身匹马而往，不能多得同志，结伴同行

dispositions.rationale: 删去记录段里带推断色彩的“给自己留了后路”和 left himself a way back，改为照述他信中的说法“他也说……”。同时补上证据中的“去志已决”。“留后路”的解读只保留在已标明“作者推断”的分析段。

evidence.quote: 则我或终归老于“文言诗国”，亦未可知

dispositions.rationale: 改写为：这一章整体是晚年口述回忆，其中引述了1916年7月6日日记和7月26日致任鸿隽信等当时文字。本文依据的只是经转引、英译与回译后的文本，未核对原件。英文同步修改。

evidence.quote: 以上九条是记载在我一九一六年七月六日的日记之中
因此在七月二十六日我就写了一封信给吾友任君

dispositions.rationale: 在唐德刚评语之后，另起一句列出胡适本人的自评「四十年来的新诗更是大有成就」，以及他对各部门发展不平均的承认。两种看法分别标明出处，英文同步修改。

evidence.quote: 则未必——至少是还未脱离
四十年来的新诗更是大有成就
新文学各部门的发展并不平均
